title: Monsoon Skincare Routine: A Light, Simple Guide for Indian Skin
ex: A light monsoon skincare routine for Indian skin: thorough cleansing, gel textures, a thin night cream and sunscreen even on cloudy days.
rt: Monsoon Skincare Routine for Indian Skin | Mirc Glow
rd: A simple monsoon skincare routine for India: cleanse well, use light gel textures, keep sunscreen on cloudy days and apply a thin layer of night cream.
quick: A good monsoon skincare routine is light: cleanse twice a day, use a gel moisturiser and SPF 30 sunscreen in the morning, and press a thin layer of night cream in at night. Dry your face after rain and keep towels and pillowcases fresh.
facts: UV reaches the skin through clouds, so sunscreen is still needed.
Humidity keeps sweat and oil on skin longer.
About half a pea of night cream is enough in humid weather.
Damp towels and pillowcases can add to breakouts.
